浏览器页面与浏览器 Worker 使用 rpc-plugin-browser；操作系统进程隔离使用 rpc-plugin-process。同载体多成员调度见 pool。
单次调用传 `signal`，以及完整的 `timeoutFeature({ ms })`、`retryFeature({ attempts })` 实例或 `false`。策略优先级是单次调用、transport feature、链路策略 plugin；未选择策略时不自动加超时或重试。取消是协作信号，不会抢占同步死循环。
Thread 的原生 `spec.limits.callWallTimeMs` 是独立硬上限；显式 `timeout: false` 只关闭可选业务 timeout，不能延长该上限。它由真实 launch spec 与同一 scheduler 创建的完整 timeout 实例执行。
`notify` 等物理写出，`request` 等业务结果。原生监管负责重启与替换；连接恢复不代表业务可安全重放。原生错误、调用错误和远端错误保留自己的 source/code/cause，跨线程传递的错误图保留 name/message/stack 与聚合成员。

README · English

Contract 只定义纯协议和接口；Host 拥有会话、目录、provider 与调用生命周期；Thread transport 获取和监管真实 Worker。flow plugin 通过固定消息介入点提供 auth、chunk、batch、probe；feature 提供所属 plugin 的 timeout、retry 或 pool。一个 Host 可以按不同命名空间安装多个 transport；本指南只需要 Thread。
父入口使用真实 `worker.js`，并将完整策略实例装在 transport 的 `features`。声明远端类型时同时保留 `typeof plugins`，以保留 namespace 和成员控制的类型。
`worker.js` 对应的子入口如下。用工具链编译 ESM，或为支持原生 TypeScript 的运行环境选实际 `.ts` 入口。相对字符串以实际主入口解析；需要固定基准时使用短配置 `{ entry, base }`。

`spawn` 与 `connectToParent` 必须恰选一个。短配置支持 `entry/name/data/limits` 和调用方提供的原生 launcher、budget、scheduler；完整 `IThreadSpawn` 保留所选原生监管配方。`name` 是注册名，`namespace` 决定 `host.<ns>`。父子身份与 generation 来自真实 bootstrap；显式 `self` 必须与实际来源一致。
`host.thread.request` 无目标时按当前直连集合调用；`send(nameOrId, method, payload, options)` 选择一个目标。`notify` 使用 `{ targetId }` 选择目标，只等实际物理写出，不等 provider 完成或 ACK。普通 namespace 有多个直连时，无目标调用返回各目标独立的结果。

`timeoutFeature`、`retryFeature` 只能是完整 feature 实例或 `false`。优先级为单次调用、transport 安装值、链路策略 plugin。上例单次调用使用 500 ms timeout，并关闭该次 retry；没有选中的策略就不自动启用。原生启动、health、stop 与业务调用的期限各有原 owner，不能用业务 timeout 推断它们的时钟。

Thread 的 `spec.limits.callWallTimeMs` 围住整个 originating 调用，包括 retry/backoff；同一原生 registration 保留其初始已准入 spec 的上限，重启或替换不会偷偷换掉该配置。较短的业务 timeout 仍可提前结束调用，`timeout: false` 不能取消该原生上限。未设置原生上限时，`timeout: false` 不自动添加期限。
`signal` 协作取消业务；处理方通过 context.signal 观察。取消不会抢占同步循环，也不等于终止 Worker。原生重启策略来自 supervisor，retry 只在实际支持的代次与业务声明条件下决定调用是否重放。未确认结果可能已执行，不能将恢复连接当成安全重试授权。
示例通过当前 `host.thread.peers.worker` 取得绑定该代的流能力。结束或提前退出时调用 `return()`；持有旧代方法不能在重启后自动变成新代方法，应重新读取当前目录。
`transfer` 传原始 ArrayBuffer，而非另造 backing。成功原生 handoff 可能转移所有权；普通复制则省略 transfer。认证通过独立 auth flow plugin 安装，应用应使用实际载体支持的组合；不要从一个底层 `postMessage` 方法推导额外认证或能力承诺。
自定义载体的真实接入路径是 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`；只读原始载体与流程观察使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`。线程资源查询只报告实际原生采样；线程共享进程 PID，不以进程 RSS 冒充单个线程内存。
原生 `messageerror` 只报告一次该诊断，不关闭仍合法的连接；诊断字符串转换失败先报告带原 cause 的转换错误。只读 probe 回调失败保留 `TRANSPORT` 与原 cause，不阻止原生投递。没有真实原生错误的主动重启/替换不会伪造 TRANSPORT cause；REMOTE_CLOSED 的代次信息仍保留。
重启后重新按 namespace 发起的无目标调用读取当时 accepted 集合；空集合使用正常 fanout 结果。此前持有的函数仍绑定原代，退场后拒绝 `TARGET_UNKNOWN`，不会自动指向新 Worker。
`host.thread.members` 提供 `list/get/stop/kill/restart/replace/on/watch`。查询可使用当前实例 ID 或注册名；stop/restart/replace 需要实际受管来源，borrowed 来源不能凭空获得 supervisor。事件与查询的身份来自原注册及实际 accepted session。

调用结束、流结束、namespace.close、Host.close 和 native kill 是不同层的操作。应用先结束自己持有的流与业务，再关闭 Host；原生资源沿实际归属释放。错误 source 可能为 `rpc.transport.thread`、`rpc.endpoint` 或 `rpc.remote`，应保留并检查其 code/cause/error graph，而非通过消息文本分类。
Run RPC on real Node, Bun, or Deno Workers.

`rpc-contract` defines pure protocol rules and interfaces. `rpc-host` owns sessions, directories, providers, call settlement, and cancellation. This transport plugin acquires, supervises, and releases native Workers. Flow plugins such as auth, chunk, batch, and probe process message flow; features such as timeout, retry, and pool attach to their owning plugin.
中文 · Usage guide
Save this as a standalone ESM TypeScript entry. Use Node 24 native TypeScript support, or compile it to ESM first. The child reloads the same entry; the guard prevents recursive spawning.
One current direct Worker returns `42`. A separate child entry can use `spawn: new URL('./worker.js', import.meta.url)` and joins with `connectToParent: true` using its actual parent bootstrap.

blocks.text: Call through `host.thread.request/notify/stream/group/send/dispatch`; use `host.thread.members` for member controls. One Host may install transports with distinct namespaces, which isolate their calls. Select the medium your application needs; using this module does not require another medium.
Use rpc-plugin-browser in browser pages and browser Workers, or rpc-plugin-process for OS process isolation. See pool for scheduling several members of this same transport.

Calls accept `signal`, complete `timeoutFeature({ ms })` and `retryFeature({ attempts })` instances, or `false`. Selection precedence is per-call options, transport features, then link-policy plugin. An absent policy adds no automatic timeout or retry. Cancellation is cooperative and cannot preempt a synchronous loop.

The native Thread `spec.limits.callWallTimeMs` is a separate hard cap. Explicit `timeout: false` disables the optional business timeout without extending that cap. A complete timeout instance uses the actual launch spec and its original scheduler.

`notify` waits for physical write; `request` waits for the business result. Native supervision owns restart and replacement. A restored connection does not establish that work can safely be replayed. Native, call, and remote errors retain their own source/code/cause; transferred error graphs preserve name/message/stack and aggregate members.

The root exports `threadPlugin`, `isThreadChild`, public options, and error identity. Custom raw carriers use `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`; readonly observation uses `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`. Ending a stream, cancelling a call, closing a namespace, closing the Host, and terminating a Worker are different operations. See the usage guide.
README · 中文

Contract defines pure protocol rules and interfaces. Host owns sessions, directories, providers, and call lifetime. The Thread transport acquires and supervises real Workers. Flow plugins provide auth, chunk, batch, and probe at fixed message hooks; features provide their owning plugin's timeout, retry, or pool. A Host may install several transports in distinct namespaces; this guide needs only Thread.

The parent uses a real `worker.js` and installs complete policies in transport `features`. When declaring remote methods, retain `typeof plugins` as well, so namespaces and member controls retain their types.

The child entry for `worker.js` follows. Compile it to ESM, or select the actual `.ts` entry in a runtime supporting native TypeScript. Relative strings resolve from the actual main entry; shorthand `{ entry, base }` selects an explicit base.

Choose exactly one of `spawn` and `connectToParent`. Shorthand accepts `entry/name/data/limits` and caller-selected native launcher, budget, and scheduler. Full `IThreadSpawn` retains the chosen supervision recipe. `name` is the registration name; `namespace` determines `host.<ns>`. Real bootstrap supplies child identity and generation; explicit `self` must agree with that source.

Untargeted `host.thread.request` uses current direct targets. `send(nameOrId, method, payload, options)` selects one target. `notify` selects with `{ targetId }` and waits only for actual physical write, without provider completion or ACK. With several ordinary direct targets, untargeted calls retain independent per-target results.

`timeoutFeature` and `retryFeature` accept complete feature instances or `false`. Precedence is per-call, installed transport policy, then link-policy plugin. The example chooses a 500 ms call timeout and disables retry for that call. No selected policy means no automatic policy. Native startup, health, stop, and business deadlines keep their respective owners; business timeout does not configure those clocks.

Thread `spec.limits.callWallTimeMs` surrounds the whole originating call, including retry/backoff. The native registration retains its initially admitted spec's cap across restart and replacement. A shorter business timeout may end the call earlier; `timeout: false` cannot disable the native cap. Without a native cap, `timeout: false` adds no deadline.

`signal` cooperatively cancels business work through provider context.signal. It neither preempts synchronous loops nor terminates a Worker. Native supervisor policy owns restart; retry decides replay only under supported generation and business-declaration conditions. Unconfirmed work may already have run, so connection recovery is not authorization to replay it.

The example obtains a generation-bound stream through current `host.thread.peers.worker`. Finish it or call `return()` on early exit. An old held capability cannot silently become a new-generation capability; read the current directory again after replacement.

Pass the original ArrayBuffer to `transfer`, without substituting another backing. Successful native handoff may move ownership; omit transfer for ordinary copying. Authentication is installed as a separate auth flow plugin. Use combinations supported by the actual carrier; a native `postMessage` method does not establish additional authentication or capability guarantees.

Custom carriers use `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`; readonly carrier/flow observation uses `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`. Resource queries report actual native samples. Threads share a process PID, so process RSS is not reported as one thread's memory.

A native `messageerror` reports that diagnostic once without closing a valid connection. Failed diagnostic conversion first reports its original cause. Readonly probe callback failures retain `TRANSPORT` and the original cause without blocking native delivery. An intentional restart/replacement without a native error does not fabricate a TRANSPORT cause; REMOTE_CLOSED retains its generation detail.

An untargeted namespace call made during restart selects the currently accepted set, using ordinary fanout results for an empty set. A previously held function remains bound to its original generation and rejects with `TARGET_UNKNOWN` after departure instead of moving to the successor Worker.

`host.thread.members` provides `list/get/stop/kill/restart/replace/on/watch`. Queries accept current instance identity or registered name. Stop/restart/replace require a genuinely managed source; borrowed sources do not acquire a supervisor. Event and query identity comes from the original registration and actual accepted session.

Call completion, stream completion, namespace.close, Host.close, and native kill are distinct operations. Finish application-held streams and work before closing the Host; native resources are released through their actual ownership. Errors may use `rpc.transport.thread`, `rpc.endpoint`, or `rpc.remote`. Inspect code/cause and the retained error graph instead of matching message text.

blocks.text: 单次调用传 `signal`，以及完整的 `timeoutFeature({ ms })`、`retryFeature({ attempts })` 实例或 `false`。策略优先级是单次调用、transport feature、链路策略 plugin；未选择策略时不自动加超时或重试。取消是协作信号，不会抢占同步死循环。
Thread 的原生 `spec.limits.callWallTimeMs` 是独立硬上限；显式 `timeout: false` 只关闭可选业务 timeout，不能延长该上限。它由真实 launch spec 与同一 scheduler 创建的完整 timeout 实例执行。
`notify` 等物理写出，`request` 等业务结果。原生监管负责重启与替换；连接恢复不代表业务可安全重放。原生错误、调用错误和远端错误保留自己的 source/code/cause，跨线程传递的错误图保留 name/message/stack 与聚合成员。
根入口公开 `threadPlugin`、`isThreadChild`、选项与错误身份。自定义原始载体使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`；只读观察使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`。关闭流、取消调用、关闭 namespace、关闭 Host 和终止 Worker 是不同操作。资源与恢复示例见使用指南。
